findings.reader: A well-bounded dated news piece that cleanly separates ordinary Chat, Work/Codex and API billing, defines each necessary term at first use, preserves rollout uncertainty, and ends with a specific proportionate check of the reader's own model picker. Both the causal explain-back and a new transfer scenario are fully supported by the mechanism as written.
findings.facts: All material claims are verbatim or directly entailed by the two official OpenAI sources, correctly attributed and bounded. Dating and source access dates make the piece reviewable, and uncertainty about rollout and account-level availability is preserved. The only note is a harmless omission of Free/Go desktop access to Luna, mitigated by the article's instruction to check one's own picker.
